s: java -Dkakasi.home=. -jar lib/kakasi.jar [-JH | -JK | -Ja] [-HK | -Ha] [-KH | -Ka] [-i<input-encoding>] [-o<output-encoding>] [-p] [-f] [-c] [-s] [-b] [-r{hepburn|kunrei}] [-C | -U] [-w] [dictionary1 [dictionary2 [,,,]]] Character Set Conversions: -JH: kanji to hiragana -JK: kanji to katakana -Ja: kanji to romaji -HK: hiragana to katakana -Ha: hiragana to romaji -KH: katakana to hiragana -Ka: katakana to romaji Options: -i: input encoding -o: output encoding -p: list all readings (with -J option) -f: furigana mode (with -J option) -c: skip whitespace chars within jukugo -s: insert separate characters -b: output buffer is not flushed when a newline character is written -r: romaji conversion system -C: romaji Capitalize -U: romaji Uppercase -w: wakachigaki mode
